description: The switch partial procedure \(S(r,j,e,d,x)\) searches triple codes \(\langle a,\langle t,k\rangle\rangle\) in numerical order. Tag zero offers the old output certified by \(b(k,e,x)>0\); tag one offers the extension output certified by \(b(k,d,x)>0\) after \(H_r(j,t)\). It returns the first successful offer and diverges if there is none.
